row.team_price_text: Pro: $52.45/month billed yearly, 2 seats included (expandable to 10)
row.evidence: Lusha's SSO guide says 'Admins and Managers on Scale plans can configure SAML SSO for their team', and Microsoft's Entra tutorial says Lusha 'supports Just In Time user provisioning'; no SCIM endpoint or provisioning feature appears in Lusha's pricing page, user guide or API docs.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. No SCIM: only JIT account creation on SAML sign-in (Entra tutorial), so status is none (JIT-only, may be reclassified at merge). Plans are per-plan prices with bundled seats (Starter $37.45/mo 1 seat; Pro $52.45/mo 2 seats; Premium $299.95/mo 5 seats; Scale custom), billed yearly, so per-user fields are null. SAML SSO (Okta, Azure/Entra or custom SAML) is Scale only (Contact sales); Google and Office 365 sign-in on all plans do not count. Okta OIN app is SAML only (no provisioning). Lusha's API is a data-enrichment API with no user-management endpoints.

plans.name: Premium
plans.price_text: $299.95 USD / month billed yearly, 5 seats included

user_api.notes: The Lusha API is a B2B data enrichment/prospecting API (contacts, companies, signals, webhooks, credit usage). Its index lists no endpoints for workspace users, teams or roles.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SAML (read from page markup); last updated Jan 2022.

entra.notes: Gallery SAML app with JIT only.

google.notes: Google sign-in is social login, not a Workspace SAML app.

fallbacks.notes: Users also join by invitation or by requesting to join an account matching their email domain.
